questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: Travelling by aeroplane is ____ than travelling by bus.
questions.explanation: Expensive is a long adjective, so it takes more: more expensive. It never takes -er.
Good is irregular: better. We never say gooder.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: A bus carries ____ people than a motorbike.
questions.explanation: The comparative of many is more: more people than. Many alone cannot compare.

options: This road is more dangerous that one.
This road is dangerouser than that one.
This road is more dangerous than that one.
questions.explanation: Dangerous is long, so it takes more, and the comparing word is than, not that.
